paragraphs.text: If you search for the Freepik AI image generator today, you end up on Magnific. On April 28, 2026, Freepik moved all of its AI tools under one name, Magnific, and the Freepik AI Image Generator became the Magnific Image Generator. Same team, same account, new address.

This guide covers what changed, how to get back into your account, where each old Freepik AI tool lives now, and which image and video models you can pick. It sticks to what Magnific itself says on its rebrand page and blog.
Why the Freepik AI image generator is now called Magnific

Magnific started as a separate AI image upscaler. Freepik bought it in May 2024, according to Magnific's own timeline. Two years later the company put its whole AI stack under the Magnific name: image and video generation, editing, voice, an API and a canvas for teams.

The business behind it is large. The Next Web, citing Fortune, reported annual recurring revenue of $230 million, more than one million paying subscribers, over 250 enterprise customers and more than four million images generated per day. Tech.eu described the company as having more than 250 million creative assets in its library.
How to log in to Magnific with your Freepik account

paragraphs.title: 1. Go to magnific.com
paragraphs.text: Magnific says magnific.com is its only official website, and that other sites still using the Freepik AI name are not run by the company. If a page asks you to pay for "Freepik AI" somewhere else, close it.

paragraphs.title: 2. Sign in the way you always did
paragraphs.text: Use the same email and password you used on Freepik, or the same Google or Apple sign in. You do not need a new account.

paragraphs.title: 3. Check your plan and credits
paragraphs.text: Magnific says your subscription and your remaining credits moved over from Freepik. If you paid for Freepik AI before the switch, that is what you should see after logging in.
Developers: Magnific says existing Freepik API keys work on Magnific, and the Freepik API is now the Magnific API. You do not need to rotate keys just because of the rename.
Old Freepik names and new Magnific names

Most tools kept their job and changed their first word. Magnific lists the renames as: Freepik AI Image Generator to Magnific Image Generator, Freepik Retouch to Magnific Image Editor, Freepik Spaces to Magnific Spaces, Freepik Background Remover to Magnific Background Remover, Freepik AI Voice Generator to Magnific Voice Generator, and the Freepik app to the Magnific mobile app.

The Image Upscaler keeps its name, since it was the original Magnific product. One new piece arrived with the rebrand: Magnific inside ChatGPT and Claude, through MCP, so you can call its tools from a chat assistant.
Which models the Magnific Image Generator uses

The image generator is not one model. Magnific says it runs Nano Banana, Seedream, Flux and more, and the video generator runs Kling, Seedance, Veo and more. The Next Web named Veo 3.1 and Seedance 2.0 among the video models you can select.

Pick the model for the job instead of sticking with one. Run the same prompt on two image models and keep the better result. Each model has its own strengths, and they all sit in the same account, so comparing costs you a few minutes.

According to Magnific's blog, the company also added Agents, MCP and Flows in June 2026, announced at its Upscale Conf in San Francisco, and launched a Business plan for smaller teams in January 2026.
What this guide does not cover

Magnific's documentation and pricing pages could not be checked for this guide, so it does not list credit costs, free plan limits or plan prices. Credit prices for AI tools change often. Check the pricing page inside your account before you start a big batch of images or videos, and compare what an image and a video cost before you queue either.

The honest summary: nothing you relied on in Freepik AI went away. The login, the credits and the API keys carry over. What changed is the name, the address and a longer list of models in one place. The main risk is the confusion itself, since lookalike sites can keep using the old Freepik AI name.
Bookmark magnific.com instead of searching for "Freepik AI" each time. It is the fastest way to avoid lookalike sites.
